tokens.title: Design Tokens
tokens.subtitle: The visual constants every VEW surface inherits. Nothing below is decoration — these are rules.
tokens.preamble.body: The interface glides effortlessly above water; the work happens below. Design so natural you stop noticing it — yet take any one piece away and the whole frame goes off.
tokens.section.color.desc: Four background steps, four text tiers, three line weights, a single restrained accent, and four semantic colors. All defined in OKLCH; close hues, low chroma.
tokens.section.type.desc: A dual-typeface system: Geist / Noto Sans SC handles every functional surface; Newsreader / Noto Serif SC appears only in moments meant to give pause.
tokens.section.space.desc: 4px baseline, eleven steps. Internal padding and gaps between elements both draw from this single ladder.
tokens.section.radius.desc: Five corner sizes. Media at 10, dialogs at 16, buttons at 6 — restrained and consistent.
tokens.section.shadow.desc: Dark mode barely uses shadows; we lean on background steps and borders. Light mode carries elevation across three soft layers.
tokens.section.motion.desc: Four curves, four durations. Components don't get to invent their own.
tokens.section.layout.desc: Desktop-first four-step breakpoint system. Container caps at 1440; the recurring gutter is 24.
type.sample.body.zh: VEW 是创作者与策展人的私人避难所。它剥离了社交平台的喧嚣，只把你收藏的视频，放在最干净的环境里。
type.sample.body.en: VEW is a private refuge for creators and curators. It strips away the noise of social platforms and frames the videos you save in the quietest environment we know how to build.
